lines.text: و بیماری سفلگان و ناکسان و وبا و فساد هوا و جستن باد سموم و حرارت هوا در آن وقت
lines.en: and the illness of the lowly and the base, and cholera, and the corruption of the air, and the blowing of the simoom wind, and the heat of the air at that time,

lines.text: و فساد میوه‌ها (رجعت زحل در برج سنبله) دلالت کند بر بغض و عداوت میان
lines.en: and the corruption of fruits. (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of Virgo) indicates hatred and enmity among

lines.text: ملوک و ولاة مملکت و رعایا و هزیمت پادشاهان جانب جنوب بولایت دیگر و جود
lines.en: kings and the rulers of the kingdom and the subjects, and the defeat of the kings of the southern side to another province, and the existence

lines.text: و ظلم فرماندهان (رجعت زحل در برج میزان) دلالت کند بر امراض متطاوله سیما درد
lines.en: and oppression of commanders. (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of Libra) indicates prolonged diseases, especially pain

lines.text: دل و گوش و دهان و مرگ بندگان و کنیزان و سقم مزاج و قلت استواء ابدان و تنگی
lines.en: of the heart and ear and mouth, and the death of slaves and slave girls, and the sickness of temperament, and the lack of straightness of bodies, and tightness,

lines.text: غم و حزن (رجعت زحل در برج عقرب) دلالت کند بر کثرت اراجیف و اضطراب عامه
lines.en: sorrow, and grief. (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of Scorpio) indicates the abundance of false rumors and the agitation of the common people,

lines.text: و صعوبت کارها و غضب پادشاه و بسته شدن کارها و یبوست هوا و دشواری مهمات
lines.en: and the difficulty of affairs, and the anger of the king, and the closing of affairs, and the dryness of the air, and the difficulty of important matters,

lines.text: و بیماری طاعون در ولایت دارالمرز و جرجان (رجعت زحل در برج قوس) دلالت کند
lines.en: and the disease of plague in the province of Dar al-Marz and Gorgan. (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of Sagittarius) indicates

lines.text: بر قلت و گرانی طعام و فتنه و آشوب در میان بندگان و مردم سفله (رجعت زحل در برج
lines.en: the scarcity and dearness of food, and sedition and turmoil among slaves and lowly people. (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of

lines.text: جدی) دلالت کند بر حدوث تشویش در عالم و اضطراب و تفرق اموال مردم و وقوع سحر
lines.en: Capricorn) indicates the occurrence of anxiety in the world, and agitation, and the dispersion of people's wealth, and the occurrence of magic,

lines.text: و مضرت رسیدن خلایق و کثرة مصادره و منازعه در میان مردم و تنازع کاری *
lines.en: and harm reaching the creatures, and the abundance of confiscation and dispute among people, and the conflict of work. *

lines.text: (رجعت زحل در برج دلو) دلالت کند بر خوف عظما و شدت برد و کثرت ثلوج در آن وقت
lines.en: (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of Aquarius) indicates the fear of the great ones, and the severity of cold, and the abundance of snows at that time,

lines.text: و بی باکی مردم و هلاک یکی از بزرگان و اهل شرف (رجعت زحل در برج حوت) دلالت
lines.en: and the recklessness of people, and the perishing of one of the great ones and the people of honor. (The retrogradation of Saturn in the sign of Pisces) indicates

lines.text: کند بر موت مردم شریف و اهل ورع و قید (احکام رجعت مشتری در بروج اثنی عشر)
lines.en: the death of noble people and the people of piety and restriction. (The judgments of the retrogradation of Jupiter in the twelve signs)

lines.text: رجعت مشتری مطلقا دلالت کند بر حیرت وزراء و مدبران و علماء و اشراف و سبق مردم
lines.en: The retrogradation of Jupiter absolutely indicates the bewilderment of viziers, and managers, and scholars, and nobles, and the precedence of people

lines.text: در کارها خیر و عزت اطعمه و بستگی کار بزرگان و اهل ناموس و تغییر در فوائد و قوانین
lines.en: in good deeds, and the honor of foods, and the closing of the affairs of the great ones and the people of honor, and change in benefits and laws,

lines.text: و ارسال رسل و رسائل میان پادشاهان (رجعت مشتری در برج حمل) دلالت کند
lines.en: and the sending of messengers and letters among kings. (The retrogradation of Jupiter in the sign of Aries) indicates

lines.text: بر هیجان اعادی بر پادشاه و خروج خوارج و افتادن زیانها و ضرر جمیع مدلولات
lines.en: the excitement of enemies against the king, and the emergence of Kharijites, and the falling of losses and harm to all the significations

lines.text: مشتری مثل وزرا و سادات و علما و فقها و اشراف و قضاة و از نباتات برنج و نخود و
lines.en: of Jupiter, such as viziers, and Sayyids, and scholars, and jurists, and nobles, and judges, and from plants, rice, and chickpeas, and

lines.text: جو و گندم و بعضی میوه‌ها و آفت طیور و وابو معشر گوید سود تجار باشد (رجعت مشتری
lines.en: barley, and wheat, and some fruits, and the pest of birds, and Abu Ma'shar says it will be the profit of merchants. (The retrogradation of Jupiter

lines.text: در برج ثور) دلالت بر ظهور خوارج و مدعیان پادشاه و خشم ملوک و بسیاری
lines.en: in the sign of Taurus) indicates the emergence of Kharijites and claimants to the king, and the anger of kings, and the abundance

lines.text: بیم و ترس در مردم (رجعت مشتری در برج جوزا) دلالت بر کثرت اراجیف و مکر
lines.en: of fear and dread among people. (The retrogradation of Jupiter in the sign of Gemini) indicates the abundance of false rumors, and deceit,

lines.text: و غدر و غرق کشتیها و تنگی و دشواری راهل کتب و خطر مردم از طغیان آب *
lines.en: and treachery, and the sinking of ships, and the tightness and difficulty of the people of books, and the danger to people from the overflowing of water. *

sections.en: And in another copy, the retrogradation of Jupiter in the sign of Aquarius is also twofold.

summary.headline: Retrogradation of Saturn and Jupiter
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Saturn’s retrogradation in Virgo through Pisces, covering disease, political conflict, famine, weather, and social unrest, followed by Jupiter’s general retrogradation and its effects in Aries, Taurus, and Gemini, including remarks by Abu Ma'shar.
